decision_basis: The frozen experiment required a full point-in-time Top-40 matched universe, but 65 of 654 decision dates have fewer than 40 eligible matched contracts and the minimum cross-section is 23.

The repository v1 research-session file audit is BLOCKED for this panel representation because it assumes globally unique/sorted timestamps and single-symbol file identity; prices_2023 also exceeds its 1,000,000-row audit bound.
Observed candidate signal evidence is adverse but cannot formally reject the exact frozen Top-40 thesis after the data contract failed.

source_corrections.feature_correction_before_freeze: cum_funding_24h is the sum of all actual funding settlements observed in the trailing 24h, not the last three settlements.

portfolio_stage_reason: Fail-closed: exact frozen data/universe contract was not satisfied. No post-hoc start-date change and no native portfolio backtest were run.
post_freeze_implementation_change: Only terminal-status precedence and append-only overwrite protection were corrected after observing the result. Signal, universe, label, thresholds and measured statistics were not changed.
next_action: A new preregistered trial would need a prospectively chosen eligible start/data contract and a panel-compatible audit representation. This run must not be reclassified as that new trial.
